question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for third-party channel plugins?
rationale: The implementation fits the repository's generic multi-consumer seam guidance, but an additive SDK export permanently promotes an internal reply-session error identity and legacy message shape into compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve The Narrow Predicate
options.body: Accept the documented predicate as the stable cross-plugin contract after live delivery proof confirms the shared semantics.

options.title: Use A Stable Error Code
options.body: Revise the core error to expose an SDK-owned code or discriminant and keep legacy message matching as internal compatibility behavior.

options.title: Keep The Surface Internal
options.body: Do not expand the SDK and require owner-local handling until a stronger third-party plugin requirement is established.

recommendation.title: Approve The Narrow Predicate
recommendation.body: Accept the documented predicate as the stable cross-plugin contract after live delivery proof confirms the shared semantics.
